target.title: fix(acp): close shared state database on gateway shutdown (#100637)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100637: The standalone ACP gateway process (`serveAcpGateway`) opens a SQLite `DatabaseSync` connection through `createSqliteAcpEventLedger()` but never closes it on SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown. This leaks file descriptors and causes SQLite file locking issues during hot reload.

The fix:
1. Tracks in-flight `handleGatewayEvent` promises
2. Drains them with a bounded 2s timeout (matching gateway pattern)
3. Closes the shared state DB via `closeOpenClawStateDatabase`
4. **Guards timed-out handlers**: after the drain timeout, a `ledgerWritesClosed` flag prevents handlers that eventually resume from writing to the ledger and silently reopening a closed DB handle through `runOpenClawStateWriteTransaction`

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/acp/server.ts` | Track in-flight events in `Set<Promise<void>>`; bounded drain (2s `Promise.race`); `ledgerWritesClosed` guard blocks writes after timeout; import & call `closeOpenClawStateDatabase`; move `onClosed()` after cleanup |
| `src/acp/server.startup.test.ts` | 5 new tests (16 total): DB close on shutdown, drain ordering, stalled-handler timeout, ledger write guard, **real DatabaseSync handle proof via `vi.importActual`** |
| `src/acp/server.shutdown-proof.test.ts` | Real `DatabaseSync` close probe (no mocks) |
| `scripts/acp-shutdown-proof.mjs` | Standalone real-process proof script |

## Evidence

### Real serveAcpGateway end-to-end proof

`server.startup.test.ts` "closes a real node:sqlite DatabaseSync handle through serveAcpGateway shutdown":
1. Uses `vi.importActual` to get the real `openOpenClawStateDatabase`/`closeOpenClawStateDatabase`/`isOpenClawStateDatabaseOpen`
2. Opens a real `node:sqlite` `DatabaseSync` handle via the real module
3. Wires the test mock so `serveAcpGateway`'s shutdown handler calls the real close
4. Runs `serveAcpGateway` → SIGINT shutdown
5. Asserts `realDb.db.isOpen === false` — the underlying C-level handle was actually closed
6. Asserts `isOpenClawStateDatabaseOpen() === false` — the module cache is cleared

### Standalone real-process proof

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/acp-shutdown-proof.mjs
=== ACP shutdown real-behavior proof ===
1. openOpenClawStateDatabase
  ok: DatabaseSync handle is open
  ok: shared state DB cache reports open
  ok: SQLite file exists on disk
2. closeOpenClawStateDatabase (ACP shutdown path)
  ok: DatabaseSync handle is closed
  ok: shared state DB cache reports closed
3. reopen after close (simulates hot-reloaded ACP process)
  ok: reopened handle is a fresh DatabaseSync
  ok: reopened handle is a new object (not stale cached)
  ok: reopened handle is closed after cleanup
RESULT: PASS
```

### Unit tests (47/47 pass)

```
server.startup.test.ts          1 passed  16 tests
server.shutdown-proof.test.ts   1 passed   1 test
event-ledger.test.ts            1 passed  12 tests
openclaw-state-db.test.ts       1 passed  18 tests
```

### Diff scope

```
 src/acp/server.shutdown-proof.test.ts |  48 ++++++
 src/acp/server.startup.test.ts        |  69 +++++++++
 src/acp/server.ts                     |  39 ++++-
 scripts/acp-shutdown-proof.mjs         |  86 ++++++++++
 4 files changed, 239 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
```

### Maintainer coordination

This PR takes the **narrowest** approach among the sibling candidates: reuse the existing `closeOpenClawStateDatabase` owner in the ACP shutdown path, bounded by a gateway-style 2s drain timeout. It does NOT introduce new API surface — all changes are confined to `src/acp/server.ts`.

Sibling PRs (#100683, #100710, #100711, #100733) can be evaluated against this bounded shared-state-close shape.
